scheme_name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Financial Support to MSMEs in ZED Certification
other_conditions: The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise (MSME).
The enterprise must be a manufacturing enterprise engaged in manufacturing activities.
The MSME must apply for ZED certification under the official program.
The enterprise must not have availed full financial support from any other government scheme for the same certification.
The MSME should comply with environmental and quality norms as per ZED standards.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹50,000 subsidy to MSMEs for ZED certification, encouraging quality improvement, energy efficiency, and eco‑friendly manufacturing.
